data.title: amp-consent: forward KV pairs from consent remote endpoint to 3p vendors
data.body:
There are use cases where the remote endpoint want to share more information in addition to the consent state to 3p vendors, such as if the current user is under certain of age or so.

We propose a generic data object named `sharedData` in the checkConsentHRref response, which will be passed along with consent state to any 3p vendors that are interested in consent state.

```
{
  promptIfUnknown: {boolean}
  sharedData: {Object}
}
```

For privacy reason, this `sharedData` is not persisted in client side storage. It will be fetched and forwarded on page view basis. 

To get this data, 3p vendor extensions can call
```
ConsentStateManager.getConsentInstanceSharedData(instanceId)
```

Master issue: #13716

data.title: amp-consent: forward KV pairs from consent remote endpoint to 3p vendors
data.body:
It doesn't make much sense to me having`<amp-consent>` pass a not used data to other extensions. Especially if we are going to support multiple consent, how would we merge multiple `sharedData`?
Would it be better for the ad to directly fetch the data? (in rtc?)
cc @keithwrightbos @jasti

data.title: amp-consent: forward KV pairs from consent remote endpoint to 3p vendors
data.body: As discussed, I think not having it passed via checkConsentHref would mean that the publisher would need to host 2 end points. The other issue is that RTC can't be triggered without user consent which is a catch 22.
